tickets.title: Reefer load rejected at 18 minutes, carrier disputes chargeback
tickets.text: Load NW-55812 was rejected at dock 3 after 18 minutes above 8 degrees C. The carrier disputes the chargeback and cites the 30 minute limit in the excursion runbook. Policy v3 says 15 minutes; chargeback upheld.

tickets.title: Cold chain probe temperature variance alert during dairy transit
tickets.text: Reefer probe calibration tolerance was tightened to 0.5 degrees C following the dairy shipment audit. The probe drift exceeded 0.8 degrees C and triggered trailer sensor replacement.
